title: The Highlight of Our Barcelona Tours
text: Pilar was by far the best tour guide we had during our trip to Barcelona! She was incredibly knowledgeable, charismatic, and passionate about her city. Her enthusiasm made our Gothic Quarter tour so engaging and gave us an even greater appreciation for Barcelona. We only wish she could have been our guide for all of our other tours! Highly recommend Pilar!
author: Estephany_A

title: Walking tour of the Gothic Quarter with Patrick
text: Patrick was wonderful, he was incredibly knowledgeable about the city and culture and enriched our experience as we started our time in Barcelona, we recommend him highly!
author: JGS6031

title: Excellent Gothic Quarter tour!
text: Alex did a great job winding us through the narrow streets of the Gothic Quarter.   he had a lot of interesting information to share about the neighborhood.     As an extra bonus, we were given free admission to the Frederic Mares Museum after the tour.   Excellent experience!
author: Sean_R

title: Awesome
text: It was a great experience. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and I would highly recommend this tour..
author: Sarah_S

title: Laura Knows Gothic Barcelona
text: Last month I signed up for a walking tour of the Gothic Quarter in Barcelona. It was absolutely wonderful thanks to our illustrious tour guide by the name of LAURA! Laura was so energetic and enthusiastic about sharing the history of each section of the areas we stopped at. Her sense of humor kept us interested in all aspects of the tour. She was extremely personable and her electric personality generated an excitement in me and also in my sister and brother-in-law to learn more and more about each historic detail. She also spoke clearly, articulately and she projected her voice loud enough so
author: 309gails

title: Amazing tour
text: Alberto was AMAZING! one of the best tour I have taken in Barcelona. He showed us the true about the Gothic quarter and took us to impressive places full of history and “secrets”. Thanks!
author: Laura_V

title: Easily walkable & very...
text: Easily walkable & very succinct summation of the history of Barcelona.  History, architecture & a museum—definite must do!
author: Ruth_M

title: Best area of Barcelona. A must see with a tour guide.
text: Best part of Barcelona. Definitely something that needs to be seen and with a tour guide. Absolutely amazing how big the area is. Love the squares and alleys.  Breathtaking.
author: Andrea_D

title: Barcelona History Tour
text: Our guide was very knowledgeable and engaging. We learned a lot about the history and culture of Barcelona. We would highly recommend this tour.
author: Kyle_R

title: Excellent tour, highly recommend
text: One of the best tours we have been on. Our guide was informative without giving too much info - just enough to digest. We moved from place to place seamlessly and managed to stay out of the heat / sun. A fascinating history and even our 8 yr old son managed the almost 2hrs without complaint!
author: Juliette_E
